ridge.context: selected time offsets across all 12 leads; offline reconstruction

cnn.context: all leads; 7 + 6*(1+2+4+8) = 97 samples, up to +/-48 samples

transformer.input: per-token P visible samples + 1 observed indicator; learned lead and fixed sin/cos time
transformer.context: bidirectional attention over all lead-time tokens

fairness: Same observed ECG values/indicator and hidden targets; receptive fields and fitting compute differ
difficulty: Raw NRMSE only. Lower is easier; no Easy/Medium/Hard policy or percentile is fitted.
